title: [issue-9341] [SDK] fix: stringify tuple/frozenset dict keys in jsonable_encoder

files.patch:
@@ -26,6 +26,13 @@ def register_encoder_extension(obj_type: Type, encoder: Callable[[Any], Any]) ->
     _ENCODER_EXTENSIONS.add((obj_type, encoder))
 
 
+def _stringify_key(key: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(key, frozenset):
+        # Set iteration order depends on PYTHONHASHSEED; sort for a stable key.
+        return "frozenset({" + ", ".join(sorted(repr(k) for k in key)) + "})"
+    return str(key)
+
+
 def encode(obj: Any, seen: Optional[Set[int]] = None) -> Any:
     """
     This is a modified version of the serializer generated by Fern in rest_api.core.jsonable_encoder.
@@ -83,14 +90,22 @@ def encode(obj: Any, seen: Optional[Set[int]] = None) -> Any:
         if isinstance(obj, dict):
             encoded_dict = {}
             allowed_keys = set(obj.keys())
+            # Keys that cannot stay as-is (hashable dataclass keys encode to a dict,
+            # tuple or frozenset keys to a list) are stringified. Native keys are
+            # placed first so a stringified key never overwrites one of them.
+            stringified = []
             for key, value in obj.items():
                 if key in allowed_keys:
                     encoded_key = encode(key, seen)
-                    if isinstance(encoded_key, dict):
-                        # Hashable dataclass keys encode to a dict, which cannot be a key.
-                        encoded_key = str(key)
-                    encoded_value = encode(value, seen)
-                    encoded_dict[encoded_key] = encoded_value
+                    if isinstance(encoded_key, (dict, list)):
+                        stringified.append((key, value))
+                        continue
+                    encoded_dict[encoded_key] = encode(value, seen)
+            for key, value in stringified:
+                text = _stringify_key(key)
+                while text in encoded_dict:
+                    text = f"{text} [{type(key).__name__}]"
+                encoded_dict[text] = encode(value, seen)
             return encoded_dict
 
         if isinstance(obj, (list, set, frozenset, GeneratorType, tuple)):

@@ -310,3 +310,31 @@ def test_pydantic_utilities__import_does_not_emit_v1_py314_warning():
         in str(w.message)
         for w in caught
     )
+
+
+def test_jsonable_encoder__dict_with_tuple_and_frozenset_keys__keys_stringified_and_values_kept():
+    encoded = jsonable_encoder.encode(
+        {
+            (1, 2): {"result": [10, 20]},
+            frozenset({3}): "set-value",
+            "regular_key": 42,
+        }
+    )
+
+    assert encoded == {
+        "(1, 2)": {"result": [10, 20]},
+        "frozenset({3})": "set-value",
+        "regular_key": 42,
+    }
+
+
+def test_jsonable_encoder__tuple_key_colliding_with_str_key__both_kept():
+    encoded = jsonable_encoder.encode({(1, 2): "t", "(1, 2)": "s"})
+
+    assert encoded == {"(1, 2)": "s", "(1, 2) [tuple]": "t"}
+
+
+def test_jsonable_encoder__frozenset_key__stringified_in_sorted_order():
+    encoded = jsonable_encoder.encode({frozenset({"b", "a", "c"}): 1})
+
+    assert encoded == {"frozenset({'a', 'b', 'c'})": 1}
